title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Change Spawned Event Names

posts.author: Fringo
Aerosys
posts.body:
I have only dealt with my own event spawn system, not with Galv's, but I think they work quite similarly.
In RPG Maker, you usually have 2 levels:
The Game_Event level: data that the event has right now, e.g. current position, current page
The $data level: data that the event has "on your disk", e.g. initial position, all the pages
By calling event() on an event, you access its data-level, which you probably should not. As you can see, it usually leads to weird or unexpected states.
So my question back to you: Why do you even want to change their names? AFAIK the names are only for us game devs in the editor; they are not used anywhere in the exported game.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: And since you wrote you just wanted to use the name to store a numerical value, you can use something like self variables (plugin) for that.

I was testing storing a number there but it turns out it does the same thing for literally any property I try to assign them ever. I tried to make a unique property called ".stats" (so it read "$gameMap.event($gameMap.events().length).event().stats = *object I want to assign*" but it still does this across all of them. It worked when I ran it to assign the object in the event scripting every time the player interacts using the ID but that isn't a solution I can use since I was literally manually using the ID numbers within the event for it. Is there another way to do this that I'm missing?
